title: 第1章 天降异象第2章 九狱炎骨现
lines: 东荒历九千七百二十三年·霜月廿三
天炎城的百姓永远不会忘记那个清晨。
当第一缕阳光刺破云层时，整片天空突然染成了血色。
赤红色的云霞如同沸腾的岩浆，从林家祖宅方向翻涌着覆盖全城。
正在早市叫卖的货郎张大嘴巴，
竹筐里的紫晶葡萄滚落一地，在青石板上映出妖异的红光。
快看天上！
醉仙楼的店小二摔碎了手中的酒坛，琥珀色的琼浆顺着台阶蜿蜒成溪流。
街道上的人群像被施了定身咒，数百上千双眼睛直勾勾地盯着九重云霄——
那里有九道燃烧的凤影正穿透云海，琉璃碎裂般的清啼声震得城楼旌旗猎猎作响。
当第九声凤啼撕裂云层时，醉仙楼檐角悬挂的青铜铃铛突然迸出蛛网裂痕。
声波如同无形的利刃划过街面，青石板缝隙间滋长出细小的赤色晶簇。
卖花妇人篮中的冰魄兰在啼声中急速枯萎，花瓣蜷曲成焦黑的灰烬。
这声音...我的耳朵！
绸缎庄掌柜跪倒在地，双手死死捂住耳孔。
指缝间渗出的鲜血滴在月白锦缎上，晕染出诡异的凤凰纹路。
声波穿透结界震碎了宗祠的琉璃窗，三长老的银须突然燃起幽蓝火苗，
被他慌乱拍灭时在掌心留下焦黑的凤爪形灼痕。
林家宗祠里，三长老手中的龟甲砰然炸裂。
苍老的瞳孔映着测灵石迸发的金红色光柱，
裂纹密布的玄火鉴在供桌上剧烈震颤。
赤霞贯日，九凤啼霄...
他枯槁的手指死死扣住太师椅扶手，
族史记载，这分明是...
九狱炎骨出世的征兆！
大长老激动的暴喝声打断了他。
这个素来沉稳的老人此刻浑身发抖，
镶着炎晶石的檀木杖在地面戳出蛛网状的裂痕，
快把产房外的结界再加固三层！
那些凤凰虚影会引来北域魔修！
产房内弥漫着浓郁的血腥气。
接生婆瘫坐在墙角，浑浊的眼珠几乎要瞪出眼眶。
她看着自己接生过三百二十八个婴孩的双手——
此刻正不受控制地泛起焦黑的灼痕，
而那个刚刚降生的婴儿周身流转着赤金色光晕。
接生婆焦黑的双手突然不受控制地抓向婴儿，
指尖生长出赤晶指甲，却在触及襁褓的瞬间被幽蓝火焰反噬。
她发出非人的惨嚎，整条手臂如破碎的陶器般片片剥落，
content_en:
Eastern Barren Calendar Nine Thousand Seven Hundred and Twenty Three Years·Twenty-three Years of Frost Moon
The people of Tianyan City will never forget that morning.
When the first ray of sunlight pierced the clouds, the entire sky suddenly turned into blood.
The crimson clouds were like boiling magma, surging from the direction of the Lin family's ancestral home and covering the whole city.
The salesman who was hawking in the morning market opened his mouth wide.
The amethyst grapes in the bamboo basket rolled to the ground, reflecting a strange red light on the bluestone.
Look to the sky!
The waiter at Zuixian Tower broke the wine jar in his hand, and the amber wine meandered down the steps into a stream.
The crowd on the street seemed to have been cast under a restraining spell, with hundreds of thousands of pairs of eyes staring straight into the sky——
There were nine flaming phoenix shadows penetrating the sea of clouds, and their clear cries, like broken glass, made the flags on the city tower rattle.
When the ninth phoenix cry tore through the clouds, spider web cracks suddenly burst out from the bronze bell hanging at the corner of Zuixian Tower.
Sound waves cut across the street like invisible sharp blades, and tiny red crystal clusters grew between the gaps in the bluestone slabs.
The orchid in the flower woman's basket withered rapidly as it cried, its petals curling into blackened ashes.
This sound... my ears!
The shopkeeper of the Satin Shop fell to his knees and covered his ears with his hands.
The blood seeping out between the fingers dripped onto the moon-white brocade, creating a strange phoenix pattern.
The sound waves penetrated the barrier and shattered the glazed windows of the ancestral hall. The silver whiskers of the third elder suddenly ignited with blue flames.
When he swatted it away in panic, it left a blackened chicken claw-shaped burn mark on his palm.
In the Lin family ancestral hall, the tortoise shell in the hands of the third elder exploded.
The old pupils reflected the golden-red light beam bursting from the spiritual stone,
The cracked Xuanhuo Jian trembled violently on the altar table.
Red clouds penetrate the sun, nine phoenixes sing in the sky...
His withered fingers clenched tightly on the armrest of the Grand Master's chair.
According to family history records, this is clearly...
Signs of the birth of the Nine Hell Flame Bones!
The great elder interrupted him with an excited shout.
This usually calm old man was trembling all over now.
The sandalwood staff inlaid with flame crystals poked spider web-like cracks on the ground.
Quickly reinforce the barrier outside the delivery room by three layers!
Those phoenix shadows will attract the Northern Territory Demonic Cultivators!
The delivery room was filled with a strong smell of blood.
The midwife sat slumped in the corner, her cloudy eyes almost bulging out of her sockets.
She looked at her own hands that had delivered three hundred and twenty-eight babies——
At this moment, black burn marks are appearing uncontrollably,
And the newly born baby was surrounded by a red-gold halo.
The midwife's blackened hands suddenly grabbed the baby uncontrollably,
Red crystal nails grew on the fingertips, but the moment they touched the swaddling clothes, they were backfired by the blue flames.
She let out an inhuman scream, and her entire arm peeled off like broken pottery.
title_en: Chapter 1: Vision from Heaven Chapter 2: Nine Hell Flame Bones Appear
